description: This file contains extension methods for string manipulation, including formatting, sanitization, and validation, within the OrchardCore.Mvc.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: StringExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for string manipulation and validation.

methods.name: CamelFriendly
methods.description: Converts a camel case string into a space-separated, more human-readable format.

methods.name: Ellipsize
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified length, appending an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: HtmlClassify
methods.description: Converts a string into a CSS class-friendly format.

methods.name: OrDefault
methods.description: Returns a LocalizedString with the text or a default value if null or empty.

methods.name: RemoveTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, optionally decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: ReplaceNewLinesWith
methods.description: Replaces new line characters in a string with a specified replacement string.

methods.name: IsValidUrlSegment
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid URL segment according to RFC 3987.

methods.name: ToSafeName
methods.description: Generates a valid technical name from a string, removing diacritics and invalid characters.

methods.name: IsLetter
methods.description: Checks if a character is an ASCII letter (A-Z or a-z).

methods.name: IsSpace
methods.description: Checks if a character is a whitespace or line break character.

methods.name: RemoveDiacritics
methods.description: Removes diacritic marks from characters in a string.

methods.name: ReplaceDiacritics
methods.description: Replaces characters with diacritics with their ASCII equivalents.

methods.name: Strip
methods.description: Removes specified characters or characters matching a predicate from a string.

methods.name: Any
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified characters are present in the string.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Checks if all of the specified characters are present in the string.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Replaces characters in a string based on a mapping from one set to another.

methods.name: ReplaceAll
methods.description: Replaces multiple substrings in a string based on a dictionary of replacements.

methods.name: ReplaceLastOccurrence
methods.description: Replaces the last occurrence of a substring within a string.

methods.name: ToPascalCaseUnderscore
methods.description: Converts a string with underscores to PascalCase.

methods.name: ToPascalCaseDash
methods.description: Converts a hyphen-separated string to PascalCase.

methods.name: ToPascalCase
methods.description: Converts a delimited string to PascalCase, with customizable delimiter handling.

methods.name: IsJson
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid JSON.
